taskText: P4 전달 대표구조 확정 및 Mesh 확인
comment:
Phase 4에 전달할 최종 SDE/SDevice 코드입니다. P4 handoff SDE는 WF-boundary refinement를 유지한 Mesh ON 코드이며 Forward 및 GIDL SDevice와 고정 SWB 파라미터를 함께 제공합니다. Mesh OFF SDE는 O04 sensitivity 비교용으로만 사용합니다.

P03-T16 / P4 handoff fixed parameters

Representative geometry
- Structure: Low-High-Low three-zone VCAT
- M1Ratio = 1
- M2Ratio = 2
- M3Ratio = 1
- Segment lengths = 15 / 30 / 15 nm
- Lg = 60 nm
- Xgate = 0.020 ~ 0.080 um
- Xbnd1 = 0.035 um
- Xbnd2 = 0.065 um

Fixed work functions
- WF_LOW = 4.33 eV (Ti)
- WF_HIGH = 4.70 eV (TiN)
- gate_m1 / gate_m2 / gate_m3 = 4.33 / 4.70 / 4.33 eV

Common parameters
- Dpillar_nm = 12
- Tox_nm = 1
- Lsn_nm = 20
- Lbl_nm = 20
- Nbody = 1e17 cm^-3
- NSD = 1e20 cm^-3
- JDepthSN_nm = 20
- JDepthBL_nm = 20
- GaussFactor = 0.8
- MeshScale = 1.0
- Temp = 300 K

Forward: VgStop=1.0 V, VdBias=0.05 / 1.0 V
GIDL: GIDLDrain=1.0 V, GIDLGateStop=-0.4 V

Final mesh handoff
- Use Mesh ON SDE (WF-boundary dedicated refinement retained).
- Mesh OFF is the T16 sensitivity-comparison case only.
